title: Evaluating the effects of body-based mindfulness interventions on psychological well-being and psychophysiological functioning in healthy adults
official: Effectiveness of a body-based mindfulness intervention on psychological and psychophysiological outcomes in healthy adults: an interventional study
summary: Not provided at time of registration
conditions: Promotion of psychological well-being and psychophysiological functioning in healthy adults.

interventions.name: The intervention consists of a structured Body-Based Mindfulness Programme aimed at promoting an integrated awareness of bodily sensations, emotional experiences, and cognitive processes. It is based on an experiential approach to mindfulness that combines formal meditation practices with body-orien

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Aged 18 years or older
2. Ability to understand the study information and participate in the intervention and study assessment procedures
3. Adequate proficiency in Italian to understand the study materials and complete the assessment procedures
4. Provision of written informed consent prior to enrolment
Exclusion criteria:
1. Presence of current mental disorders or clinically significant psychological conditions
2. Current or recent psychological or psychiatric treatment, including psychotherapy and/or psychopharmacological treatment
3. Medical or physical conditions that may significantly interfere with participation in the intervention or completion of the study assessments
